Worse, the failure is silent: the fail-open convention treats a missing block as "unknown, no adjustment," which is indistinguishable in the pack from a genuine `unknown` verdict on live data — so on a `weekly_market` depth the gather can drop the block entirely and nothing surfaces it. The fix is small: have the gatherer emit `momentum_health` on every depth (weekly included) and, when it genuinely cannot compute, emit an explicit `{"status": "unavailable", "reason": ...}` stub so the pack distinguishes "the factor is fine" from "nobody looked."
